entries.name: Companion loyalty quests: finish before the late-game siege chapters
Make a manual save before starting the final chapters
Collect Sealed Abyss Artifacts before grinding challenges (tracking trap)
Back Alley Cleanup (Above the Law)
entries.how: Doesn't count bounties you finished before you started it. Do it before turning in all your bounties. One later report says a patch fixed this, but nobody has confirmed it.

entries.name: Into the Barrage: hit 5 enemies with one cannon shot (Battle)
entries.how: Only a few chances, mostly during Chapter 8's big battles. Bring a cannon into those fights.

entries.name: Marni Laser Helm (Special Weapons)
entries.how: Only the regular version counts. Don't upgrade it to the Kuku version before the challenge registers. Keep all 10 special weapons un-upgraded until the category is done.
entries.unlocks: Grand Collector of Arms, Unvanquished Strategist

entries.name: Keep the Vessel of Dark Pursuit (Special Weapons)
entries.how: Don't sell or donate it. There's no known way to get another one.
entries.unlocks: Grand Collector of Arms, Unvanquished Strategist

entries.name: Disruption: needs Jackal enemies (Operation)
entries.how: Jackals stop spawning in Pailune once its camps and faction quests are cleared. Patch 1.05's Re-Blockade may bring them back.

entries.name: Sinking Fort watchtower (Battle)
entries.how: The watchtower may not come back after you liberate every enemy base. Do it before clearing the last bases.

entries.name: Barraging Cannon V watchtower (Cannon)
entries.how: Same risk as Sinking Fort: finish it before liberating every base.

entries.name: Hold off clearing enemy camps until challenges are done
entries.how: Several challenges need live camps or enemies, and quests can't be replayed after the story (free roam stays open).
